Name: ThrowableBombs
Author: aike4869
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
[b]Throwable Bombs[/b] is my custom-made gameplay mod for Stardew Valley. It lets you throw Cherry Bombs, Bombs, and Mega Bombs instead of simply placing them at your feet.
Aim with your cursor and press [b]G[/b] to throw. On an Xbox controller, aim with the right stick and press [b]RB[/b]. A dotted arc previews the throw. Bombs can travel up to eight tiles by default. If a target tile is blocked by a stone or another object, the bomb will try to land on a nearby empty tile. Bombs that hit a wall fall nearby and continue their fuse. They can also collide with monsters and knock them back.
Throw a bomb into water and it sinks before exploding after a delay. The splash and number of catches vary by bomb type. Catches are generated using the location’s native fishing logic, so results depend on the water and current fishing conditions. Fish quality is influenced by Fishing level, and fish may grant a small amount of Fishing experience, subject to a per-bomb cap. Other native fishing results, including trash, may also appear.
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.1.8[/b] or later.[/*]
[*]Download and extract the archive.[/*]
[*]Place the
[code]ThrowableBombs[/code]folder inside your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI. The mod creates its configuration file automatically.[/*]
[/list]To uninstall, close the game and remove the
[code]ThrowableBombs[/code]folder from
[code]Mods[/code].
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Throw Cherry Bombs, Bombs, and Mega Bombs.[/*]
[*]Aim with the mouse or Xbox controller right stick.[/*]
[*]Use [b]G[/b] on keyboard or [b]RB[/b] on Xbox controller.[/*]
[*]Preview the throw with a dotted arc.[/*]
[*]Bombs try nearby empty ground when the target is occupied.[/*]
[*]Wall collisions, monster collisions, and knockback.[/*]
[*]Water bombs sink, use a delayed fuse, create tiered splashes, and produce fishing catches.[/*]
[*]Bomb types have different splash sizes and catch amounts.[/*]
[*]Host-authoritative online multiplayer support.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements and Compatibility[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15[/b] or later.[/*]
[*]SMAPI [b]4.1.8[/b] or later.[/*]
[*]For online multiplayer, every player must install the same version of this mod.[/*]
[*]Split-screen multiplayer is not supported.[/*]
[/list][heading]Beta Notice[/heading]
This mod is in beta. Recent fixes have passed compilation and automated regression checks, but still need broader in-game verification. Online multiplayer has not been fully tested between two computers. Please include your SMAPI log, mod version, location, controls used, and reproduction steps when reporting a bug. Remove personal information from logs or screenshots before sharing them.
[heading]Special Thanks[/heading]
Thanks to everyone who has tried the mod, shared feedback, and helped identify bugs.
